parts.title: Into the Woods
parts.text: Finn, Maya, and Diego walked on a **trail** in the woods. The air felt cool in the **shade**. Maya found a round **acorn** and put it in her pocket. Dry leaves began to **rustle** by a log.

parts.title: Little Homes
parts.text: Diego looked up and saw a **nest** on a high **branch**. Three small eggs sat inside. Then Finn saw a **hidden** hole under a tree. One long **whisker** poked out of it. It was the **den** of a little chipmunk.

parts.title: A Lonely Friend
parts.text: The chipmunk came out and looked **lonely**. The children sat very still. The chipmunk began to **creep** closer. Maya gave it a bit of her snack. The chipmunk took it and began to **scurry** home.

parts.title: Goodbye, Friend
parts.text: The friends waved goodbye. They had made a new friend in the woods. They walked home with happy smiles.
